author: KEXP
description: The self-titled debut from musical duo Croz Boyce captures the human experience through tender instrumentals. Live on KEXP with host Alex Ruder, Dave Portner (Avey Tare) and Brian Weitz of Animal Collective join together to share a performance of "Townson Acid" and more.
title: Croz Boyce performs "Townson Acid" & more Live on KEXP
